kills.change_summary: Remove the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance so deposits no longer increase Acc[msg.sender].balance.

kills.property: For any fuzzed unlock time, Put must store acc.unlockTime = max(_unlockTime, block.timestamp) i.e. never a time already
kills.change_summary: Set acc.unlockTime directly to _unlockTime instead of clamping it to at least the current block timestamp.

kills.property: After any successful Put call, Put remains callable again (reentrancy lock is always released); the mutant leaves locked
kills.change_summary: Remove the 'locked_ = false;' reset at the end of the nonReentrant_ modifier so locked_ stays true and all subsequent Put calls revert.

kills.property: Each Put must ADD msg.value to the sender's existing balance (two consecutive deposits accumulate to their sum); the mut
kills.change_summary: Replace the safe addition with a direct assignment so the recorded balance ignores prior deposits.

kills.property: For every admissible input, after Put(t) the stored unlock time satisfies Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime >= block.timestamp
kills.change_summary: Always set the unlock time to _unlockTime, even when it is in the past, so Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime after Put differs.

kills.property: For any funded caller and any positive amount, a successful Put must append a History entry in the Log recording exactly
kills.change_summary: Delete the log call so Put no longer records an entry in the Log contract.
